crossRefs.note: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

translations.web: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
translations.bsb: His tail sways like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are tightly knit.
translations.kjv: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
translations.asv: He moveth his tail like a cedar: The sinews of his thighs are knit together.
